questions.target: 题干对象 / 评价对象匹配
questions.skill: 关键词相似前先核对主语
questions.q: A review says: “The report contains pages of anecdotes and too little analysis of why small firms avoid the subsidy.” It later adds: “The subsidy’s most serious weakness is that participation falls once temporary bonuses end.” If asked what the report fails to do, which answer is best?
o: explain adequately why small firms avoid the subsidy
produce participation that lasts after bonuses end
remove all anecdotes from the discussion
prove that temporary bonuses never increase participation

exp.trans: 评论先说报告轶事过多，却没有充分分析小企业为何避开补贴；后面又说补贴本身最严重的问题是奖金结束后参与度下降。若题干问“报告没做到什么”，答案应回到报告本身。
exp.structure: 第一句The report是被评价对象；第二句The subsidy’s most serious weakness把评价对象切换成补贴政策。题干再次锁定the report。
exp.other: anecdote 轶事；subsidy 补贴；participation 参与度；temporary bonus 临时奖励。
exp.meaning: 看到most serious weakness之类强信号不能直接选，先检查这个weakness属于谁。正确选项可以只改写并列句中的一侧，不必覆盖整句所有批评。
exp.rest: “produce participation that lasts...”描述的是subsidy的持久效果，不是report的写作缺陷；“remove all anecdotes”把too many夸大成必须全部删除；“prove...never”加入绝对化的never和原文没有的证明要求。

questions.q:
Even after I explained the joke twice, my brother still missed the point.
missed the point 在这里表示什么？
o: 仍然怀念以前的笑话
仍然没明白笑话的关键
忘记了一个标点符号
没赶上兄弟聚会

exp.trans: 即使我把这个笑话解释了两遍，我弟弟仍然没有明白其中的关键。
exp.structure: 主句：my brother（主语）+ missed（谓语）+ the point（宾语）。after从句：I + explained + the joke；twice修饰explained。even强调即便已经解释过，结果仍如此。
exp.other: joke 笑话；twice 两次；still 仍然；explain 解释。
exp.meaning: miss the point整体表示没领会关键、没明白意思，不能把miss机械地译成怀念。
exp.rest: miss sb可表示想念某人，但miss the point不是这一义项。标点符号一般是punctuation mark，不是这里的point。miss a meeting可表示错过聚会，但原句没有meeting；brother是主语，不是被错过的活动。

questions.q: Even after the company simplified its procedures, a few managers continued to cling to the old rules. Here, cling to means:
o: 向上攀爬
紧抓着不愿放弃
公开批评
快速修改

exp.trans: 即使公司简化了流程，仍有少数经理继续死守旧规定。
exp.structure: Even after...是让步背景。主干：a few managers（主语）+ continued（谓语）+ to cling to the old rules（补足内容）。cling to的宾语是the old rules。
exp.other: simplify 简化；procedure 流程；continue to do 继续做；old rules 旧规定。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓、依恋、不愿放弃。注意cling不是climb。
exp.rest: climb才是“攀爬”；公开批评是criticize openly；快速修改是revise quickly。这里语境是明知规则已简化仍不愿放弃旧做法。

questions.target: 个人估计 vs 集体验证
questions.skill: 区分主张起点和取得认可所需条件
questions.q: An analyst estimates that the city has room for 4,000 people in emergency shelters. Officials will use this figure for evacuation plans only after independent teams verify the counts and agree on a common estimate. What makes the figure suitable for official planning?
o: The analyst's personal familiarity with the shelters.
Verification and agreement across independent teams.
The public release of a large numerical estimate.
The analyst's decision to avoid revising the original number.

exp.trans: 一位分析员估计城市应急避难所可容纳4000人；只有独立团队核查数据并就统一估计达成一致，政府才会在疏散计划中采用这一数字。
exp.structure: An analyst + estimates + that从句提出最初主张；Officials + will use + this figure ... only after ...，only after指出主张转化为官方依据所需的条件。
exp.other: emergency shelter 应急避难所；evacuation 疏散；estimate 估计；verify 核验。
exp.meaning: 题干问的是让一项初步主张获得认可所需要的机制。个人估计是起点，独立团队核查与达成一致是条件；不能因为看到analyst就选个人经验。
exp.rest: 个人熟悉情况只能解释估计如何产生；数字公开和规模大都不能自动证明可靠；拒绝修订反而与核查机制相冲突。

questions.target: 具体反对行动支持哪条主旨
questions.skill: 例子→论点 / 不能多推态度变化
questions.q: A city report says proposals to digitize building permits have repeatedly stalled because established interests resist change. It cites a builders' association that organized petitions and delayed the new system for six months. What does the example mainly illustrate?
o: Organized groups can impede administrative reforms.
The association persuaded every resident to change political allegiance.
Most builders oppose the current political system in all circumstances.
Digital permits always cost more than paper applications.

exp.trans: 城市报告说，建筑许可数字化改革屡次被既有利益团体阻挠，并举建筑协会组织请愿、使新系统推迟六个月的例子。例子说明利益团体可能阻碍行政改革。
exp.structure: 主句proposals ... have stalled because...提出上层论点；It cites an association ...是作为证据的例子；organized petitions / delayed是例子中的行为与结果。
exp.other: digitize 数字化；permit 许可证；established interests 既有利益集团；administrative reform 行政改革。
exp.meaning: 例证题先找例子附近作者要证明的论点：改革遭遇阻力。组织请愿不等于改变公众政治立场；反对一项改革也不等于反对整个政治制度。
exp.rest: 政治归属改变需要前后态度证据；所有情况下反对现行政治制度扩大对象与频率；数字许可成本并未涉及。

questions.q:
The archive contains several letters. The historian based her argument on those letters.
最自然的合并是：
o: The archive contains several letters on which the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which on the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters on that the historian based her argument.
The archive contains several letters which the historian based her argument on them.

diag.1: 介词 on 应放在关系代词 which 前，不能写 which on the historian...
diag.2: 介词后不能用关系代词 that；应使用 which。
diag.3: which 已经代替 those letters，后面再用 them 造成重复。

exp.trans: 这个档案馆收藏着几封信，历史学家正是依据这些信件提出了她的论证。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：The historian based her argument on those letters. → those letters 变成先行词 several letters，并用 which 代替：the letters which the historian based her argument on → 正式写法把介词前置：the letters on which the historian based her argument。
exp.other: archive 档案馆；historian 历史学家；base A on B 以B为依据建立A；argument 论证/观点。
exp.meaning: 介词 + which 用于物；介词来自原简单句中的搭配 base A on B。
exp.rest: 介词前置的正确句是 “letters on which ...”；把 which 放在 on 前、把 that 放在介词后，或在 which 后再保留 them，都会造成词序或关系词重复问题。

questions.target: 态度确有变化 vs 是否由活动造成
questions.q: After a public campaign, a survey of the same 500 residents found support for the new bus plan had risen from 30% to 55%. During the same period, a fare cut was also announced. What is the most defensible conclusion?
o: The campaign alone caused every changed opinion.
Support was measured to have risen, but the campaign's independent causal effect is not established.
There is no evidence anyone's opinion changed.
The fare cut certainly had no influence on residents.

exp.trans: 一场宣传活动之后，对同一批500名居民的调查发现，新公交方案支持率从30%升至55%；与此同时还宣布降低车费。能确定支持率发生变化，但不能断定全由宣传活动造成。
exp.structure: a survey ... found + that支持率变化；During the same period引入另一同时发生的因素，阻止将全部变化归因于campaign。
exp.other: fare cut 降低票价；resident 居民；causal effect 因果效应；establish 证实。
exp.meaning: 这次确有前后态度数据，因此不能机械否认变化；但‘变化发生了’与‘某活动单独导致变化’仍是两回事。推断题要守住证据提供的层级。
exp.rest: alone和every绝对化且忽略票价变化；‘没有证据变化’与同群体前后调查冲突；完全排除票价影响没有依据。

questions.target: 工资涨幅 vs 福利形式
questions.q: The hospital increased nurses' basic pay by only 1%, but expanded subsidized childcare and doubled its contribution to their retirement accounts. Which conclusion is best supported?
o: Every nurse's cash salary doubled.
The hospital eliminated all non-wage benefits.
The overall reward package improved partly through benefits beyond basic pay.
The hospital cut pension support to finance the salary increase.

exp.trans: 医院只把护士的基本工资提高了1%，却扩大了托育补贴，并将其养老金账户的雇主缴费翻倍。合理结论是报酬待遇部分通过工资以外的福利改善。
exp.structure: The hospital + increased + basic pay ... but expanded ... and doubled ...；but对照基本工资小幅增长和两种福利的明显增加，结论应兼顾两边。
exp.other: subsidized childcare 托育补贴；contribution 缴费、投入；retirement account 退休金账户；reward package 总体报酬待遇。
exp.meaning: basic pay / cash salary与benefits / pensions不能混为一谈。工资表面增幅modest并不排除实际待遇因非工资福利而indirectly augmented。
exp.rest: 基本工资翻倍与only 1%冲突；取消福利与expanded相反；削减养老金支持与doubled contribution直接相反。

scope-role-match.target: 并列信息 / 主语对象
scope-role-match.skill: 正确选项可对应并列句一侧
scope-role-match.q: A critic writes: “The study gives a detailed history of the device but offers little investigation of the failures reported in cold weather.” Two sentences later: “The device’s clearest flaw is that its battery loses capacity after repeated freezing.” What does the study fail to do?
o: provide any historical background
investigate the cold-weather failures sufficiently
prevent the battery from losing capacity
make the device work indefinitely in freezing conditions

exp.trans: 评论者说研究对设备历史讲得很详细，但对寒冷天气中的故障调查不足。后面说设备本身最明显的缺陷是反复结冰后电池容量下降。题目问study，因此答案是调查不足。
exp.structure: but连接两个对study的评价：history详细，failure investigation不足；后句The device’s clearest flaw把主语切到device。
exp.other: capacity 容量；freezing 冰冻环境；investigation 调查；critic 评论者。
exp.meaning: 并列句里一半信息就可以被题目抽出来做同义替换。不要因为答案没同时复述history和failure两侧就排除。
exp.rest: “provide any historical background”与detailed history相反；要求study去prevent battery loss或让device indefinitely work in freezing conditions，都是把研究报告与设备本身的职责混在一起。

point.q: The committee spent twenty minutes arguing about the font on the warning sign, while the real issue was whether the bridge was safe. They were clearly ___.
o: missing the point
making a point
reaching the point
pointing out

diag.1: make a point 常表示“提出观点/特意强调”，这里强调的是没抓住真正问题。
diag.2: reach the point 需要具体语境，如 reach the point where...，不能表达“没抓住重点”。
diag.3: point out 通常后接宾语，表示“指出”；这里既不合结构也不合语义。

exp.trans: 委员会花了二十分钟争论警示牌的字体，而真正的问题是这座桥是否安全。他们显然没有抓住重点。
exp.structure: 第一句：The committee（主语）+ spent（谓语）+ twenty minutes（宾语）；arguing...说明时间花在何事上。while连接对比；whether the bridge was safe作表语从句。第二句：They（主语）+ were missing（现在进行时谓语）+ the point（宾语）。
exp.other: committee 委员会；warning sign 警示牌；issue 问题/争议点；safe 安全的。
exp.meaning: miss the point = 没抓住重点、没理解关键。point 在这里是“要点/关键”，不是“节点”。
exp.rest: make a point = 提出/强调观点；reach the point = 达到某个阶段/程度；point out = 指出某事。只有 missing the point（没抓住重点）符合他们纠结字体却忽视桥梁安全的语境。

point.target: point / there is no point in doing
point.q:
With the last bus already gone, there was no point in waiting at the stop.
point 在这里最接近：
o: 联合会
尖端
分数
意义、用处

exp.trans: 末班车已经开走了，继续在车站等也没有意义。
exp.structure: 主干：there was no point in waiting at the stop，是there be存在句。With the last bus already gone补充原因背景。简单句The last bus was already gone → 去掉was，用with + 名词 + 状态补语压缩。
exp.other: last bus 末班车；already 已经；be gone 已经离开、不在了；bus stop 公交站。
exp.meaning: there is no point in doing sth：做某事没有意义；point不是物理位置上的点。
exp.rest: 联合会常用federation/association，与句意无关。尖端可用the point of a needle，必须是具体物体的尖端。分数可说score three points，但这里不是计分语境。

point.q: “Residents have a point: the evening bus reaches the station after the last train has left.” What does have a point convey?
o: 居民的意见有道理，时刻表提供了理由。
居民已经同意公交运营方的安排。
公交晚到导致火车晚点。
居民指出了一个新的候车地点。

exp.trans: “居民说得有道理：晚班公交抵达车站时，末班火车已经离开了。”问题问have a point表达什么。
exp.structure: Residents是主语，have是谓语，a point是宾语。冒号后的the evening bus + reaches + the station给出理由；after从句的has left表示火车先已离开。
exp.other: resident 居民；station 车站；the last train 末班火车；timetable 时刻表。
exp.meaning: have a point表示某人的意见有道理或值得考虑。这里肯定的是意见所据的理由，不是找到一个地点；与miss the point不同，这次是抓到了有效理由。
exp.rest: “同意运营方”加入了原文没有的立场，且解释的是时刻衔接不便。“导致火车晚点”倒置了时间信息：火车已走，并未晚点。“新的候车地点”把抽象的意见或道理误当具体地点。

cling-climb.q: The frightened child ___ tightly to his father's arm as the boat lurched through rough water; when the boat reached the dock, he did not try to ___ over the safety barrier.
o: climbed / cling
clung / climb
clung / climbed
climbed / climb

exp.trans: 船在颠簸水面上摇晃时，受惊的孩子紧紧抓住父亲的手臂；船靠岸后，他没有试图翻过安全护栏。
exp.structure: 第一分句：The frightened child + clung tightly to + his father's arm，tightly修饰clung。第二分句：he + did not try + to climb over + the safety barrier。clung是cling的过去式；climb是不定式原形。
exp.other: frightened 害怕的；tightly 紧紧地；lurch 突然摇晃；rough water 颠簸的水面；reach the dock 到达码头；safety barrier 安全护栏。
exp.meaning: cling to = 紧抓不放；climb over = 翻越/爬过。两个词形相近，但动作和搭配不同。
exp.rest: climbed tightly to his father's arm不符合“紧抓手臂”的语义和搭配；try to climbed over把过去式误放在不定式to后；climbed / climb的第二空虽可成立，但第一空仍不对；cling over不符合固定搭配。只有clung / climb同时满足两处语法和语义。

process-stage-role.target: 单次发现 vs 跨来源确认
process-stage-role.skill: 过程终点与条件的角色识别
process-stage-role.q: A driver first reports cracks on a bridge, but the warning is not issued to the whole region until engineers compare photographs, inspect the structure, and confirm the hazard. What is required for the initial report to become an official warning?
o: A more vivid description from the first driver.
Agreement that the first driver deserves public credit.
Public enthusiasm for an alarming photograph.
Independent assessment and confirmation of the reported danger.

exp.trans: 司机最先报告桥面裂缝，但直到工程师比对照片、检查结构并确认危险，地区警报才正式发布。
exp.structure: A driver + reports + cracks引入起点；the warning + is not issued ... until engineers compare, inspect, and confirm，用not...until表示形成正式警报的必要过程。
exp.other: crack 裂缝；structure 结构；hazard 危险；issue a warning 发布警报。
exp.meaning: 个人首次报告不等于正式被认可；由多个步骤进行独立评估并确认，才使主张具有可推广的效力。注意题目问required而非who noticed it first。
exp.rest: 报告更生动不能替代核验；给报告人荣誉不是警报成立条件；公众情绪不能替代工程检查。

example-claim-scope.target: 例子同样可以说明支持改革
example-claim-scope.skill: 不能靠团体行动推固定结论
example-claim-scope.q: An article argues that locally organized groups can sometimes help an unpopular policy get started. It describes a farmers' cooperative that trained volunteers and persuaded members to test a water-saving system, helping the trial begin on schedule. What is the role of this example?
o: It proves every member had opposed water conservation before joining.
It shows cooperatives necessarily control the national government.
It establishes that all unpopular policies eventually succeed.
It supports the claim that organized groups can facilitate policy implementation.

exp.trans: 文章认为地方组织有时能帮助不受欢迎的政策启动，随后举农民合作社培训志愿者、推动成员试用节水系统，使试验按时开展的例子。这个例子是在支持‘团体也能帮助政策落实’。
exp.structure: An article argues + that从句是主张；It describes...引出实例；helping the trial begin是实例中的实际结果。
exp.other: cooperative 合作社；facilitate 促进；implementation 落实；trial 试行。
exp.meaning: 例子支持的结论可以是促进改革，也可以是阻碍改革，取决于前后文。不要机械地把‘团体动员’与‘妨碍改革’绑定。
exp.rest: 成员加入前态度没有交代；合作社对国家政府的控制与本文无关；一次成功试行不能保证所有政策最终成功。

relative.q:
The plumber thanked the neighbour. He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour.
哪句合并正确？
o: The plumber thanked the neighbour from that he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom from he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder.
The plumber thanked the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from him.

exp.trans: 水管工感谢了那位借梯子给他的邻居。
exp.structure: 原始简单句：He had borrowed a ladder from the neighbour. → 用whom替代重复的the neighbour：the neighbour whom he had borrowed a ladder from → 把from前置：the neighbour from whom he had borrowed a ladder。外层主干是The plumber + thanked + the neighbour，后接修饰neighbour的定语从句。
exp.other: plumber 水管工；neighbour 邻居；ladder 梯子；borrow A from B 从B那里借来A。
exp.meaning: from不是临时猜出来的，来自原句borrow...from...；先行词是人，介词后用whom。
exp.rest: from that：关系代词that不能直接置于介词后。whom from he：介词前置时必须是from whom，不是whom from。from him：关系代词whom已经代替该人，再保留him造成重复。

inference-boundary.target: 重新审视惯例 vs 无依据的未来结果
inference-boundary.skill: 推断必须有直接语义支撑
inference-boundary.q: An architect argues: 'When an old street layout fails its users, we should question the layout instead of assuming that pedestrians are the problem.' Later the article mentions plans to renovate the district. Which view is most directly supported by the architect's remark?
o: Old designs should be reconsidered when experience reveals their limits.
Every renovation will inspire a generation of future architects.
Pedestrian choices have no effect on city traffic.
New designs should always replace old ones, even when they work.

exp.trans: 建筑师认为，旧道路布局若不能服务使用者，就应质疑布局本身，而不是预设行人有问题。引文支持反思既有设计，而非预言未来创新的效果。
exp.structure: When从句给出条件；we should question A instead of assuming B是核心主张。Later句子另行交代翻修计划，但没有为引文添加未来代际因果关系。
exp.other: layout 布局；pedestrian 行人；renovate 翻修；reconsider 重新考虑。
exp.meaning: 引用某人的一句话，优先提炼这句话本身可支持的思考方式。与文章主题有关的后续结果可能合理，但若引文没谈到，就不能据此归给说话人。
exp.rest: 鼓舞未来建筑师引入未提及的影响链；完全否认行人作用和一律淘汰旧设计，都比原话更绝对。

inference-boundary.target: 思考方式 vs 后代研究因果
inference-boundary.q: A historian says of a newly revised account: 'The documents did not change; the questions I asked of them did.' The article later notes that her book was reprinted thirty years later. What does her statement most strongly suggest?
o: An influential book must be reprinted before its argument becomes valid.
Repeatedly publishing the same documents automatically produces new discoveries.
Revisiting familiar evidence with different questions can yield new interpretations.
The historian's method necessarily shaped every later generation of researchers.

exp.trans: 历史学家说：文献没有改变，改变的是我向它们提出的问题。这表明熟悉的证据也能因为新的提问方式产生新解释。
exp.structure: The documents did not change与the questions ... did形成对照；did代替did change，省略重复的动词原形change。后句reprinted thirty years later说的是再版事实，不包含对后代研究的必然影响。
exp.other: historian 历史学家；document 文献；reprint 再版；interpretation 解释。
exp.meaning: ‘旧材料+新问题→新解释’是引文直接支持的内容。后面提及多年后再版，并不能证明她影响了所有后来研究，更不能把时间先后直接改成因果。
exp.rest: 把再版当成论证有效性的必要条件属于添加规则；自动产生发现与提问改变的机制不符；对所有后代研究产生必然影响远超引文证据。

inference-boundary.skill: 行动证据与态度变化证据
inference-boundary.q: A tenants' group rallied 800 long-time supporters at a public hearing against a proposed rent increase. No survey of participants' earlier opinions was conducted. Which statement is warranted?
o: The campaign converted 800 opponents into supporters.
The gathering shows mobilization of supporters, not necessarily a change in their prior attitudes.
The group persuaded the city to cancel the proposal.
All residents now oppose rent increases.

exp.trans: 租户组织动员了800名长期支持者，在公开听证会上反对拟议涨租。没有调查这些参与者以前的观点。只能确认组织动员了支持者，不能确认他们是被说服后改变立场。
exp.structure: A tenants' group + rallied + long-time supporters；No survey ... was conducted明确缺失了对以前态度的测量。Which statement is warranted要求只说证据足以支持的内容。
exp.other: tenant 租户；rally 动员；hearing 听证会；prior attitude 先前态度。
exp.meaning: rally supporters是组织已有支持者采取行动；change someone's political attitude要有前后立场变化的证据。动员和说服是不同关系。
exp.rest: 转化反对者需要原先反对的证据；城市撤销提案未被提及；把800名支持者扩大为所有居民属于范围过度扩大。

compensation-components.target: 公开工资表 vs 延后福利
compensation-components.q: A port authority's new contract capped immediate wage increases at 2%. Negotiators nevertheless won additional paid leave and retirement payments that workers would receive years later. Why might the published wage table understate the agreement's value?
o: Because future benefits add compensation not visible in current wage increases.
Because the wage table proves that workers lost all holiday entitlement.
Because capped wages show that pensions must have been reduced.
Because only the highest-paid managers can receive retirement benefits.

exp.trans: 港务局新合同将近期工资涨幅限制在2%，但谈判代表争取到更多带薪休假和多年后领取的退休福利。因此只看当前工资表，会低估协议的总体价值。
exp.structure: A port authority's contract + capped + wage increases；Negotiators + won + leave and payments；years later修饰后续领取时间。Why题要解释工资表遗漏了哪一部分。
exp.other: cap 限定上限；port authority 港务局；negotiator 谈判代表；paid leave 带薪休假。
exp.meaning: backloaded compensation指把部分报酬安排在之后或以福利形式提供。不能把工资涨幅不大误读为整体待遇没有提高，更不能凭空判定增长‘过度’。
exp.rest: 原文明确增加假期而非失去假期；养老金被削减与additional retirement payments相反；限定只给高管没有证据。
